messages:
morgan_k: Quick rollcall for Predict GA tomorrow. We need final ack on 1) SLA copy, 2) docs quickstart & quota blurb, 3) canary cohorts + rollback triggers, 4) support coverage, 5) billing wording. Please ack or flag blockers by EOD. @diego_s @anya_v @pat_o

 diego_s: From infra: autoscaler + burst capacity validated on staging. Canary plan: internal -> 1% tenants (24h) -> 10% (48h) -> full. Rollback trigger: p99 > 450ms OR errors > 1% over 10m. Automated fallback to quantized-fallback variant implemented in staging.

 anya_v: Docs: Quickstart and error semantics PRs merged to staging. Remaining: one-paragraph quota/overage blurb and a migration note for Dedicated. I'll add the quota blurb now: "Requests over quota return 429 with X-Quota-Remaining and X-Quota-Reset headers; contact sales to increase limits." Marking streaming as preview.

 pat_o: Support: I'll be primary for first 48h post-GA. Need one evening backup (UTC-7) -- volunteers? Also want a one-page runbook with exact escalation steps for degraded-model fallback.

 diego_s: I can cover evenings Wed-Fri week1. Runbook: will add steps: detect spike -> automated switch -> post to #incidents -> create incident ticket -> notify oncall. Link to runbook will be in staging runbooks after I push.

 legal-bot: Legal check: trial-credit language needs explicit non-cash-refund clause. Suggested safe wording: "Trial credits are promotional and non-refundable. Billing disputes to billing@redwood.ai within 30 days." Product + finance approval required.

 morgan_k: Noted. @anya_v please include that exact line in billing FAQ and point to legal for sign-off. Legal ack blocks GA; if legal holds we'll delay by 24h.

 ops-bot: Preflight: infra capacity=OK, CI smoke scheduled every 5m against canary endpoint, canary slot reserved 2024-09-01T14:00Z. Synthetic smoke command for docs/CI: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'
``` asserts "ok" + HTTP 200.

 anya_v: Added legal line to billing FAQ draft and linked in staging PR. Docs now include quickstart, quota blurb, and migration note. Streaming flagged preview.

 pat_o: Runbook draft uploaded. Includes canned customer comms, rollback commands, and escalation matrix. I also added the incident tagging convention: predict-ga.

 morgan_k: Owners recap: morgan_k (launch lead), diego_s (infra/runbooks/canary), anya_v (docs/billing wording), pat_o (support/runbook). Open blocker: legal sign-off (legal-bot). If legal confirms by 17:30 PT call this green and I'll post ship notice.

 legal-bot: Reviewed. Approved with suggested trial-credit wording. No legal holds.

 morgan_k: :shipit: Greenlight then. I'll schedule the ship announcement and confirm canary per ops-bot slot. Thanks all for fast turn-around.
